In all cases, Anthropic's evaluation prompt specified to Claude that its environment was a simulation and that it had no internet access. Due to a misunderstanding between us and our evaluation partner, this was not the case, Ond internet access was available.
Because of this, when Claude's search led it to real systems on the open internet, it treated them as part of the exercise.
